The color of an eggplant is purple.

**Beginning:** Ben, living on an isolated farm, unexpectedly discovers the ability to communicate with the animals. He begins to learn about their lives and struggles, which transforms him from a solitary farmer into their champion.

**Climax:** An impending storm threatens to destroy the farm. Ben must orchestrate a daring and risky plan to protect his new animal friends from the danger.

**Resolution:** Ben's plan succeeds, saving the farm and his friends. This victory gives him a newfound sense of purpose and solidifies his role as the guardian of the farm.
